stories.text: 🔮 PROJECTION FLIP: Gibb it to Me Baby is now projected to beat Ruffing the Passer.
🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Moose Knucklers has been laid to rest (15.79 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🗑️ DROP REGRET: Drake Maye averaged 7.5 before 49er Faith-Fool cut him in Week 4. Since: 30.1 a week. Now he's helping Brock You Like a Hurricane.
🏟️ Game to watch: NE @ CHI (Thursday 8:15 PM), 14 league starters in action with 153.38 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (NE @ CHI): 14 league starters, led by Brock You Like a Hurricane vs Mr. Action Jackson.
🔁 In hindsight: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: In My Fantasy Era leads the chopping-block odds at 41%, with Mel's Mediocre Mob next at 24%.
🔭 Player to watch: A.J. Brown (NE @ CHI). ESPN projects 16.25 pts, and Ruffing the Passer is 42% against Gibb it to Me Baby.
🪑 Bench of broken dreams: Kirbo Crushers has started Khalil Shakir just once. Starting him in Weeks 1, 4, 5 and 6 would have meant 2 more wins by now.
🔥 TDsMaGee has won 3 straight. Claremont In Yo Stace! gets the next crack at them.
🔁 Retro trade: If TDsMaGee and Kirbo Crushers had swapped RJ Harvey for Dallas Goedert back in Week 1, both would be ahead (+1 and +3 wins).
📉 Stock falling: Kirbo Crushers' ESPN projection is trending down.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 19% against Claremont In Yo Stace! — and won.
